prompt: In which year did Dina Nath Walli (an Indian watercolor artist and poet from Srinagar city) return to Srinagar, where he concentrated on landscape painting in watercolors?
answer: Dina Nath Walli returned to Srinagar in **1936**, where he focused on landscape painting in watercolors.
